dependency_identity_limit: The original 400-cell certificate has archived actor code available for 150 cells. Mechanisms for the remaining primary cells are inferred from frozen configuration, audited current source, and recorded neutral contracts. GRPO archived-source availability is reported per cell (none of its 75 archived actor sources are locally available). Installed vLLM 0.8.4 dependency files are hashed in the primary certificate but not cryptographically bound to every historical execution. Mapping-based deduplication and disjoint-seed sensitivity must be explicitly conditional on this historical mapping assumption; older cohorts need not be excluded.
global_prompt_seed_scope: The learner uses one parent seed per draw, and the actor reuses it for every neutral prompt. Where per-prompt request seeds are recorded, they are checked against that parent. Empty older request-seed lists do not establish independent prompt streams. vLLM forks parent + sample index, so the same nominal child seed is reused across prompts and matched conditions. Different prompt distributions and batching can yield different texts under coupled PRNG streams. This certificate does not establish iid prompts, independent draws or conditions, or exact repeatability.
statistical_handling: Retain the original K8 draws for historical P,D reconstruction. Fix earliest (draw_index, sample_index) selection for each nominal stream without reference to keys, rewards, or agreement. Duplicate agreement is provenance information only; disagreement does not justify outcome-selected exclusions. Parent-seed reuse across prompts means iid-prompt standard errors remain an inference assumption, not a certified fact. No effects were computed here.
